shell.contract: Host-owned validated dock, project expansion and sidebar preferences; atomic persistence, revisioned broadcasts and concurrent-view operations.

preview.contract: Host-owned trusted Module Federation descriptor and authenticated assets/HMR proxy; shared MCP tool dispatch, separate React root in thin browser panel.

shared-host.contract: Existing shared host modules, tools, hooks and MCP logic; source reachability is not behavioral acceptance.

environment.contract: Host-owned effects, uploads into /workspace, browser downloads, clipboard and navigation.

server.contract: Pinned upstream settings HTTP requests; configured credential remains host-owned.

files.contract: Bridge FilePanel container reads/writes/watches and host-owned logical view snapshots.

file-panel-control.contract: Validated process-local logical-view projection: per-chat open order, active file, main selection/context, attach toggle and preview choice. Does not retain drafts, undo, scroll or host-restart state.

transport.contract: Known-channel invocation and private authenticated wire forwarding.

presentation.contract: Host-owned chat snapshots, prompts and read-only resync.

terminal.contract: Shared host-owned PTY registry with 5000-line parsed screen and sequenced private reattach snapshots; page is a disposable projection. OSC palette/pixel/window reports remain unaccepted.

title.contract: Shared BridgeHost /rename ingress validates live tabs; native SessionsBridge keeps title metadata through its callback.
